title: Why Do We Have Leap Years?
hook: Earth's trip around the sun is not a perfect 365 days.
narration: Earth's trip around the sun is not a perfect 365 days.
It is about a quarter-day extra.
Every four years we add February 29.
That extra day keeps calendars honest.
